title: 航空構造設計
subtitle: Aircraft Structure Design
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) Features of aircraft structures (2) Basic concepts of aircraft structural design under static loads (3) Basic concepts of aircraft structural design under fatigue loads (4) Mechanics of composite laminates
advice: On the basis of knowledge learned in subjects such as Industrial Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure, student will learn the basic concepts of aircraft structural design. We will cover the following materials: (1) Design load of aircraft (limit load, ultimate load, load factor, V-n diagram) (2) Basic concepts of structural design methods under static loads (Strength ratio, Margin of safety) (3) Basic concepts of structural design methods under fatigue loads (Safe life design, Damage tolerance design) (4) Mechanics of composite materials (Mechanics of composite lamina and composite laminate) Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure before taking this course.
books: Textbooks: Basics of Mechanics of Materials (in Japanese) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of Industrial Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the meanings of 'limit load' and 'ultimate load'
Be able to evaluate the static strength of aircraft structure using strength ratio or margin of safety
Regarding the fatigue strength of aircraft structures, be able to explain the concept of damage tolerance design
Be able to calculate the stiffness matrix of composite laminates and explain the mechanical behavior

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) Fully understand the 'limit load' and 'ultimate load' and draw a V-n diagram (2) Evaluate the static strength of aircraft structures using the strength factor or margin of safety. Utilize these to improve structural design (3) Understand the concept of fracture mechanics. Explain the concept of damage tolerance design in regard to fatigue strength of aircraft structures (4) Calculate stiffness matrix of composite laminate and explain its mechanical behavior
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain the difference between 'limit load' and 'ultimate load' (2) Evaluate the strength of aircraft structures under static loads using the strength factor or margin of safety (3) Calculate the crack growth behavior under fatigue load and evaluate the residual strength (4) Calculate the stiffness matrix of composite laminate

lessons.content: Course introduction 1 Design load (1) load factor
[Mini test 1] 2 Static strength (1) Tension of bar, Bending of beam
2 Static strength (1) Tension of bar, Bending of beam
[Mini test 2] 2 Static strength (3) Bending of thin-walled beam with stiffener
2 Static strength (3) Bending of thin-walled beam with stiffener
[Mini test 3] 3 Fatigue strength (2) damage tolerance design
[Mini test 4] 4 Mechanics of composite laminate (1) Mechanics of lamina
4 Mechanics of composite laminate (1) Mechanics of lamina
[Mini test 5] 4 Mechanics of composite laminate (2) Mechanics of laminate

lessons.assignments: Self-evaluation on achievement in this subject
